canonical_title: Holistic Assessment Design and Clustering Competencies

one_line_answer.text: Holistic assessment design is an integrated approach combining knowledge, skills, attitudes and ethics.

cites.quote: This refers to an integrated approach to assessment design which seeks to combine knowledge, understanding, problem solving, technical skills, attitudes and ethics into assessment events.

bangla_explanation: Holistic design-এ knowledge, skills, attitudes আর ethics একসাথে মূল্যায়ন করা হয়।
বাস্তব কাজ একটা unit-এ আটকে থাকে না, তাই কয়েকটি unit একসাথে clustering করা হয়।
এতে assessment বাস্তব কাজের মতো হয় আর সময় ও resources বাঁচে।
Clustering হলো integrated assessment design-কে সাহায্য করার একটা উপায়।

example.en: In one bakery task, a trainee follows safety, measures ingredients and bakes bread. Several units are assessed together.
example.bn: একটি বেকারি কাজেই safety, মাপজোখ আর বেকিং একসাথে assess হয়।

short.prompt: What are two benefits of clustering competencies when designing assessment?
short.modelAnswer:
Clustering means one assessment event covers more than one unit of competency. Benefits:
1. It reflects real ways of working.
2. Evidence for all the dimensions of a competency is more readily available.
3. It is an efficient use of time and assessment resources.

keyPoints.text: An assessment event can cover more than one unit of competency by clustering.

cites.quote: An assessment event can cover more than one unit of competency at a time by clustering of the competencies.

keyPoints.text: Gathering evidence can apply to part of a unit or an entire qualification.

cites.quote: The process of gathering evidence can apply to part of a unit, a whole unit, a cluster of units or an entire qualification.

keyPoints.text: Holistic assessment design often collects evidence from more than one unit of competency.

cites.quote: Holistic assessment design often involves collecting evidence from more than one unit of competency.

keyPoints.text: The Assessment Plan documents where clustering is appropriate.

cites.quote: It is important that the Assessment Plan documents where clustering is appropriate.
